::: {.excel-operation}
**Where in PEExcel?** [🔎 var]{.excel-menu .red} (**Variantenvergleich**).
:::

Compare results of saved configurations, investigating individual measures and packages on the same accounting basis.

::: {.excel-path}
**Ribbon:** klimaaktiv PEQ → Ergebnisse → [Vergleich]{.excel-action}
:::

::: {.excel-operation}
**Setting up a comparison**

1. Calculate and save the required variants individually or by [batch](batch.qmd).
2. Select the comparison group on **Variantenvergleich**.
3. Restrict chart ranges to the variants actually being assessed.
4. Ensure consistent areas, boundaries, weather and assessment assumptions; document deliberate differences.
:::

![Primary-energy comparison of individual measures and combinations. This training figure does not show the website's three Bsp refurbishment variants.](../media/manual/variant-comparison.png){.manual-figure}

## Interpreting balances together

Envelope quality changes heat demand; PV changes generation and supply timing; flexible building services and storage shift imports. Mobility measures affect an additional boundary. Read combined effects from the calculated package, not by simply adding isolated improvements.

Primary-energy charts also include context contributions. These are assessment quantities, not additional physical generation.

[Real refurbishment examples: four balances](examples.qmd) · [Managing variants](variants.qmd)

Source: [Training, slide 33](../downloads/schulung.pdf#page=33) (German).

## Example: storage capacity and charging power

Save a reference without a stationary battery and variants with 10 and 20 kWh. For each capacity, test C-rates of 0.5 and 1 h⁻¹. Keep PV, weather, uses and comfort band unchanged. Resulting powers are 5, 10, 10 and 20 kW.

Compare self-consumption, autonomy, imports, peak feed-in, losses, full cycles and GHG balance. These numbers illustrate an experiment, not a sizing recommendation. [Hourly profiles](excel-dashboard.qmd) explain whether larger capacity is used or power is the main limitation.
